# Synthetic Data Dictionary

**All data described here is 100% synthetic and fictional.** It was generated by
`src/generate_synthetic_data.py` using a fixed random seed (42) for a fictional
organization, "Northstar Financial Group," and its fictional internal GenAI
assistant, "Northstar Assist." No real company, employee, customer, or usage
data was used or referenced in any way. Nothing here should be interpreted as
representing RBC, TD, or any real financial institution.

This dictionary covers the **raw** files in `data/raw/`. Raw files intentionally
contain data-quality issues (duplicates, missing values, inconsistent labels,
invalid values) so the cleaning pipeline (Phase 2, `src/transform_data.py`) has
real, documented problems to solve. Cleaned/normalized versions will live in
`data/processed/`.

---

## 1. `users.csv`

Grain: one row per user per HR feed load. Intentionally contains ~8 exact
duplicate rows (simulating a duplicate data-feed load) — `user_id` is unique
only after de-duplication.

| Column | Type | Example | Source (synthetic) | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| user_id | string | `U00042` | Synthetic HR/identity feed | Unique employee identifier. Not unique in raw file due to intentional duplicate rows. |
| business_unit | string | `Retail Banking` | Synthetic HR feed | One of 8 business units. Raw file contains inconsistent label variants (e.g. `retail banking`, `RETAIL BANKING`, `Risk & Compliance`, `TECH`) that must be normalized. |
| role | string | `Analyst` | Synthetic HR feed | One of 8 job roles. |
| region | string | `Canada - East` | Synthetic HR feed | One of 6 fictional regions. |
| manager_level | string | `Individual Contributor` | Derived from role | One of `Individual Contributor`, `People Manager`, `Senior Leader`. |
| hire_date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | `2021-03-14` | Synthetic HR feed | Employee's simulated hire date, always before rollout start. |
| assigned_access_date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) or blank | `2026-02-02` | Synthetic entitlement system | Date the user was granted access to Northstar Assist. Blank for some ineligible users (missing-value case). |
| rollout_wave | integer 1-6 | `2` | Synthetic rollout plan | Which of 6 rollout waves (4 weeks each) the user was assigned access in. |
| training_assigned_date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | `2026-01-30` | Synthetic LMS feed | Date training was assigned to the user, near `assigned_access_date`. |
| training_completed_date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) or blank | `2026-02-10` | Synthetic LMS feed | Date the user completed training. Blank if not completed. |
| training_format | string | `Self-Paced eLearning` | Synthetic LMS feed | One of `Live Virtual`, `Self-Paced eLearning`, `In-Person Workshop`, `Manager-Led Briefing`. |
| manager_champion_flag | boolean or blank | `True` | Synthetic HR/enablement feed | Whether the user's manager is a designated "AI champion." ~1% intentionally blank (simulated feed gap). |
| eligible_for_access_flag | boolean | `True` | Synthetic entitlement system | Whether the user is officially eligible for the tool per HR/entitlement rules. A small share of ineligible users still show an `assigned_access_date` — an intentional entitlement-lag data-quality issue. |

**Known raw-file issues (by design):** ~8 duplicate rows; inconsistent
`business_unit` capitalization/abbreviation on ~40 rows; ~60 blank
`manager_champion_flag` values; blank `assigned_access_date` for roughly half
of ineligible users.

## 2. `usage_events.csv`

Grain: one row per user interaction event with Northstar Assist.

| Column | Type | Example | Source (synthetic) | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| event_id | string | `EVT0001234` | Synthetic application telemetry | Unique event identifier. Raw file contains ~0.4% exact-duplicate `event_id` rows (simulated at-least-once delivery). |
| user_id | string | `U00042` | Synthetic application telemetry | Foreign key to `users.csv`. |
| event_timestamp | string (usually `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`) | `2026-02-03 14:22:10` | Synthetic application telemetry | When the event occurred. A small number of rows contain malformed/invalid strings or dates that predate the user's `assigned_access_date` (intentional data-quality issues). |
| session_id | string | `S-U00042-20260203` | Synthetic application telemetry | Groups events into a user-day session. |
| feature_name | string or blank | `Knowledge Search` | Synthetic application telemetry | One of the 8 catalog features. Raw file contains label variants (e.g. `Doc Summarization`, `chat and research`) and a small number of blanks. |
| event_type | string | `prompt_submitted` | Synthetic application telemetry | One of: `access_granted`, `app_opened`, `prompt_submitted`, `output_generated`, `output_exported`, `feature_completed`, `help_opened`, `error_encountered`, `feedback_submitted`. |
| prompt_category | string | `Research` | Synthetic application telemetry | Free-form category tag describing the type of prompt/task. |
| output_exported_flag | boolean | `True` | Synthetic application telemetry | Whether the output was exported (e.g. copied/downloaded). |
| successful_completion_flag | boolean | `True` | Synthetic application telemetry | Whether the action completed successfully (always `False` for `error_encountered`). |
| estimated_minutes_saved | float or blank | `12.5` | **Modeled estimate**, not a measured value | Simulated minutes saved for successful completion/export/feature-completion events. This is a modeled assumption, not validated ROI. A small number of rows are intentionally negative (data-quality issue). |
| session_duration_seconds | integer | `184` | Synthetic application telemetry | Duration associated with the event. A small number of rows are intentionally negative (data-quality issue). |
| error_flag | boolean | `False` | Synthetic application telemetry | `True` only for `error_encountered` events. |
| platform | string | `Web` | Synthetic application telemetry | One of `Web`, `Desktop App`, `Teams Plugin`, `Outlook Plugin`, `Mobile`. |
| source_system | string | `Northstar Assist Web` | Synthetic application telemetry | System that logged the event, derived from `platform`. |

**Known raw-file issues (by design):** ~950 duplicate `event_id` rows; ~177
malformed/invalid `event_timestamp` values; a subset of events timestamped
before the user's access date; ~713 negative `session_duration_seconds`
values; ~713 negative `estimated_minutes_saved` values; ~475 blank
`feature_name` values; inconsistent `feature_name` label variants.

## 3. `feedback.csv`

Grain: one row per feedback submission (a user may submit multiple over the rollout).

| Column | Type | Example | Source (synthetic) | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| feedback_id | string | `FB000123` | Synthetic in-app survey | Unique feedback identifier. Raw file contains a handful of exact duplicates. |
| user_id | string | `U00042` | Synthetic in-app survey | Foreign key to `users.csv`. |
| feedback_timestamp | string (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`) | `2026-03-01 09:15:00` | Synthetic in-app survey | When feedback was submitted. |
| rating_1_to_5 | integer | `4` | Synthetic in-app survey | Star rating. A small number of rows intentionally contain out-of-range values (`0`, `6`, `-1`) as a data-quality issue. |
| sentiment_label | string | `Positive` | Derived (with noise) from rating | One of `Positive`, `Neutral`, `Negative`. |
| barrier_category | string | `No time to learn` | Synthetic in-app survey | One of 8 fixed barrier categories (see below). |
| free_text_feedback | string or blank | "I know Northstar Assist could help but..." | **Fully synthetic, templated text** — not real employee statements | Short synthetic comment. ~7-8% intentionally blank (user skipped the free-text box). |
| feature_name | string or blank | `Drafting Assistant` | Synthetic in-app survey | Feature the feedback pertains to; ~20% blank (general feedback not tied to a specific feature). |
| would_recommend_flag | boolean | `True` | Synthetic in-app survey | Whether the user would recommend the tool, correlated with `rating_1_to_5`. |

Barrier categories: `No time to learn`, `Unsure what use cases are allowed`,
`Low output quality`, `Hard to find the right feature`,
`Privacy or compliance concern`, `Lack of relevant training`,
`Tool performance issue`, `No barrier reported`.

**Known raw-file issues (by design):** a handful of duplicate `feedback_id`
rows; ~15 out-of-range `rating_1_to_5` values; ~572 blank
`free_text_feedback` values; ~1,545 blank `feature_name` values (expected/
non-error, general feedback).

## 4. `training_sessions.csv`

Grain: one row per instructor-led/scheduled training session (aggregate
counts, not individual attendance records — individual attendance/completion
is separately reflected in `users.csv`'s `training_assigned_date` /
`training_completed_date`, which may also include self-paced completions not
tied to a specific session in this table — see
`docs/assumptions_and_limitations.md`).

| Column | Type | Example | Source (synthetic) | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| training_session_id | string | `TR0007` | Synthetic LMS/session log | Unique session identifier. |
| session_date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | `2026-01-20` | Synthetic LMS/session log | Date the session ran. |
| business_unit | string | `Technology` | Synthetic LMS/session log | Business unit the session was organized for. |
| training_format | string | `Live Virtual` | Synthetic LMS/session log | One of the 4 training formats. |
| registered_count | integer | `85` | Synthetic LMS/session log | Number of employees registered. |
| attended_count | integer | `70` | Synthetic LMS/session log | Number of employees who attended (≤ registered_count). |
| completion_count | integer | `61` | Synthetic LMS/session log | Number of attendees who completed the session's requirements (≤ attended_count). |
| facilitator | string | `M. Chen` | Synthetic, fictional name | Fictional facilitator name — not a real person. |
| session_topic | string | `Prompt Writing Basics` | Synthetic LMS/session log | One of 5 fixed training topics. |

## 5. `feature_catalog.csv`

Grain: one row per Northstar Assist feature (8 rows total).

| Column | Type | Example | Source (synthetic) | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| feature_id | string | `F01` | Synthetic product catalog | Unique feature identifier. |
| feature_name | string | `Knowledge Search` | Synthetic product catalog | One of the 8 features. |
| feature_category | string | `Research & Knowledge` | Synthetic product catalog | One of `Research & Knowledge`, `Productivity`, `Enablement`, `Technical / Analytical`. |
| target_persona | string | `All Employees` | Synthetic product catalog | Intended primary audience for the feature. |
| release_date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | `2026-01-05` | Synthetic product catalog | Date the feature became available (core features release at rollout start; `Data Analysis` and `Code Assistant` release later, in weeks 5 and 7). |
| core_feature_flag | boolean | `True` | Synthetic product catalog | Whether the feature is considered part of the "core" broadly-targeted set. |

## 6. `calendar.csv`

Grain: one row per calendar day across the 24-week rollout window
(2026-01-05 to 2026-06-21, 168 days).

| Column | Type | Example | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | `2026-02-03` | Calendar date. |
| week_start_date | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | `2026-02-02` | Monday of the ISO-style rollout week containing `date`. |
| week_number | integer 1-24 | `5` | Rollout week number. |
| month | integer 1-12 | `2` | Calendar month. |
| month_name | string | `February` | Calendar month name. |
| quarter | integer 1-4 | `1` | Calendar quarter. |
| year | integer | `2026` | Calendar year. |

---

## Reminder

Every figure above — user counts, event counts, ratings, minutes saved,
barriers, quotes — is randomly generated synthetic data for a fictional
company. It is intended solely to demonstrate an analytics workflow and must
never be presented as real enterprise data, real ROI, or real user feedback.
